item.title: Resident Evil Requiem Is Getting A Themed MicroSD Express Card
item.description: Capcom previously confirmed the physical version is a Game-Key Card.Resident Evil Requiem arrives on the Switch 2 next month and apart from a pro controller, watches, bags and amiibo, there'll also a themed microSD Express Card.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Surprise! Splatoon 3's First Update Of 2026 Has Added Health Bars
item.description: We weren't expecting this!Nintendo released a major update for Splatoon 3 this week, and in case you missed it, it adds health bars to the game.This has come as a real surprise to Splatoon players, as up until now, the enemy's health in multiplayer was displayed through visual cues. As Nintendo notes, the remaining health of opponents will now be shown above their heads for "a few seconds" when they're visible. Certain abilities can also make this bar visible.Read the full article on nintendolif

item.title: Digital Foundry Delivers Its Tech Review Of Grid Legends On Switch 2
item.description: Here's how it holds up.GRID Legends: Deluxe Edition speeds onto the Switch 2 this week, and it just might be the best-looking game to date on Nintendo's new hybrid system.Digital Foundry has now taken a look, and here's exactly what you can expect when it comes to the game's performance and resolution across the docked and handheld modes.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Keiji Inafune's Mighty No. 9 Studio Comcept Is Finished
item.description: It was officially dissolved earlier this month.The video game company Comcept, originally founded by Keiji Inafune in December 2010, has been "officially dissolved by a shareholders' resolution" earlier this month on 13th January 2026.A notice was published about this today in Japan's government gazette Kanpo (thanks for the heads up, Gematsu).Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: DAMON and BABY Is A Twin-Stick Shooter With A Twist, Arriving On Switch In March
item.description: Genre fusion.Arc System Works' DAMON and BABY didn't particularly grab our attention when it was teased back in the busy release schedule of last November, but the game's new eShop page — and accompanying 25th March launch date — encouraged us to take a closer look. And it's got to be said, there's some funky mechanical fusion going on in here.DAMON and BABY is part action/adventure game, filled with puzzles and platforming, and part twin-stick shooter, filled with... well, twin-stick shooting.
